claim: Compatibility with the published NMEA 2000 and binary SDK interface, with the bounds and deviations documented in docs/actisense.md.
implemented: Bounded BDTP framing, escaping, checksums, Type-1 and Type-2 BST
BST-93/94 gateway messages, BST-95 raw CAN, BST-D0 assembled messages
CAN ASCII mode 6 and NMEA 2000 Type-A ASCII parsing and emission
EBL reading, writing, replay and live wire tracing
TCP, serial and custom byte streams; serial settings and port enumeration
Typed local BEM and bounded multi-reply response accumulation
Typed remote BEM through Client and gateway session PGN 126720
Mode-preserving control sessions and generic BST/raw sends
Documented Rx-mask/Tx-rate sentinels and explicit PGN-list transactions
Legacy F1 lists and port duplicate deletion
Raw single/multi-response BEM escape hatches, diagnostics and metrics

specification_gaps.reason: Deprecated model-specific baud-code layouts are undocumented and absent from the compiled SDK; modern command 17 is supported.
Analogue payload layouts remain TBD in the SDK and have no compiled implementation.

specification_gaps.feature: Firmware upload and additional EMU/PRO configuration
specification_gaps.reason: No implementable protocol supplied in this SDK.

specification_conflicts.resolution: Follow the compiled SDK nine-byte NAME and stored-address layout. The conflicting Markdown layout is not presumed to be a firmware contract.
